name: Pinball Arcade: No Fear - Dangerous Sports
storyline: No Fear: Dangerous Sports (1995) combines extreme sports with extreme pinball. Created by a design team led by Steve Ritchie, players are challenged with competing in the most daring events in the air, snow, asphalt, dirt and water. These include free climbing, water skiing, super-cross, extreme skiing, auto racing and more! The playfield features excellent flow with easy-to-follow shot lights and a talking skull who calls out what to aim for. The magnetic ball accelerator sets players up to take a flying leap across the Jump Ramp's void. A little danger makes it a lot of fun! 4,540 units of this table were produced.
